tasks.subject: Trace insert-mode Shift-Tab behavior
tasks.description: Investigate whether the repo ever had an insert-mode Shift-Tab mapping or indent-related setting that made Shift-Tab move left in Neovim, and compare current behavior/history to determine whether a repo change caused the regression.

tasks.subject: Compare removed nvim mappings
tasks.description: Compare the old deleted nvim/mappings.vim against current Neovim Lua config to identify which mappings/features were not migrated. Summarize lost mappings and note any replacements or behavior changes.

tasks.subject: Restore insert Shift-Tab outdent
tasks.description: Add Neovim insert-mode mappings so Shift-Tab and BackTab outdent again, while preserving previous completion-item selection when the completion popup is visible.

tasks.subject: Commit Shift-Tab fix
tasks.description: Create a git commit containing only the Neovim insert-mode Shift-Tab/BackTab outdent fix, excluding unrelated unstaged changes already present in the repo.
